meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Foreign investment inflows (DBIE report 34, new format)
meta.coverage: Foreign investment flows every month since April 2011: direct investment into India (gross, repatriation, net), Indian direct investment abroad, portfolio flows
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 34 (new format), US$ million, monthly. Direct investment to India is gross inflows minus repatriation; FDI by India is net of its own repatriation. Portfolio flows here are FPI net purchases as reported, monthly.
